assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game scenery sprite atlas, not a concept sheet or screenshot.
Create one 2048x2048 transparent PNG sprite sheet in an EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows equal cell grid. SIXTEEN isolated environmental objects for an original illustrated monster-tamer browser world. Each object entirely inside its own 512x512 cell with at least 35px empty transparent padding, same orthographic three-quarter overhead viewpoint, ground contact centered near the bottom of each cell. No overlaps between cells. Genuine transparent alpha background, no white or checkerboard painted into image. No text, borders, labels, grid lines, people, monsters or watermark.
Style: polished hand-painted 2.5D cozy fantasy RPG scenery, broad readable silhouettes with painterly material detail, soft warm upper-left light, delicate darker contour accents, believable volume and charming craft. Palette: sage and apple green leaves, golden grass, warm bark and cream cottage walls. Not flat geometric vector shapes. Each cell depicts only its specified prop with minimal attached ground and soft contact shadow.
Cells in row-major order, left to right then top to bottom:
1: broad old oak tree
2: slender birch tree
3: layered fern thicket
4: gnarled mossy tree
5: mossy boulder cluster
6: small wildflower patch with stones
7: wooden plank footbridge viewed from above
8: root-framed dark cave entrance
9: gigantic hollow oak with a small doorway
10: split fallen tree forming a forest arch
11: living root cathedral with a shallow reflecting pool
12: roof-open mossy sinkhole with roots
13: cream cottage with rounded green tiled roof
14: open-air herbalist stall
15: small sanctuary pavilion surrounding a luminous blue basin
16: wooden notice board and travel lantern
Keep camera angle, light direction and visual scale consistent. This is an actual sprite atlas for integration, with all sixteen complete sprites individually separated.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: tileable top-down game ground material atlas, nine terrain textures for a hand-painted 2.5D fantasy browser RPG.
Create one square 1536x1536 OPAQUE image arranged as EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows of nine equal square texture cells. Each cell completely filled edge-to-edge with its material; no gutters, borders, labels or text. View each material from straight overhead, even diffuse light, no perspective, shadows, horizon, objects or large focal features. Fine painterly natural texture, small low-contrast details, soft material variation, seamless edges within each tile. These are ground texture swatches, NOT miniature landscapes.
Row 1 left to right: 1 sage/apple-green meadow grass with tiny clover leaves; 2 muted teal-green moist riverbank grass; 3 warm ochre dry heath grass with subtle fine straw.
Row 2: 4 desaturated indigo-green moonlit moss and tiny silver leaves; 5 chalky sage-and-gold short alpine prairie grass; 6 desaturated charcoal warm-grey ash ground with fine brown fragments and very sparse fresh moss.
Row 3: 7 pale warm beige earth path with fine grit and occasional tiny pebbles; 8 pale grey aged limestone paving, small worn irregular stones with restrained joints; 9 dark cool grey cave floor of weathered rock and scattered fine grit.
Restrained contrast; all materials sit behind readable game characters. No flowers, buildings, animals, logos, UI, watermark, shadows or grid lines. Exactly nine filled material swatches.
